description: 圆柱形桌面笔筒，薄壁带底
description_en: Cylindrical desktop pen holder, thin wall with closed bottom
code:
import cadquery as cq

# === 参数 ===
outer_d = 80     # 外径 (mm)
height = 100     # 高 (mm)
wall = 2         # 壁厚 (mm)
bottom_t = 2     # 底厚 (mm)

# === 外筒 → 抽壳成杯 (顶面开口) ===
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(outer_d / 2)
    .extrude(height)
    .faces(">Z").shell(-wall)
)

# === 底外缘小圆角，改善附着不翘边 ===
result = result.edges("<Z").fillet(1.5)

show_object(result)
